synopsis: New at Milan's Saint Mary's, June is swept into secrets and lies: no one is who they seem, and love may hide behind the mask of the last boy she'd fall for.

title: Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King
synopsis: In a world where magic is everything, Asta, a boy who was born with no magic, aims to become the "Wizard King" to overcome adversity, prove his power and keep his oath with his friends.

title: Jackass: Best and Last
synopsis: Follows the Jackass crew as they perform their final series of dangerous stunts and pranks, marking the end of the franchise.

title: De Gaulle: Liberté
synopsis: 1943–1944. To free France, General de Gaulle must unite a divided Resistance. He also fights to establish his legitimacy with the Allies.

title: Pretty Lethal
synopsis: A group of ballerinas try to escape from a remote inn after their bus breaks down on the way to a dance competition.

title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
synopsis: Desperate to be a big guy, SpongeBob sets out to prove his bravery to Mr. Krabs by following the Flying Dutchman, a mysterious swashbuckling ghost pirate, to the deepest depths of the deep sea.

title: Protector
synopsis: Former war hero Nikki's peaceful life is shattered when her daughter is kidnapped. Thrust into the criminal underworld while hunted by cops and military, she must fight to rescue her child.

title: Gabriel's Inferno: Part One
synopsis: An intriguing exploration of seduction, forbidden love, and redemption, a captivating and passionate tale of one man's escape from his own personal hell as he tries to earn the impossible: forgiveness and love.

title: Gabriel's Inferno: Part Two
synopsis: Professor Emerson learns the truth about Julia but his realization comes too late. Julia is done waiting for him to remember her and wants nothing more to do with him. Can Gabriel win back her heart before she finds love in anothe...

title: Gabriel's Inferno: Part Three
synopsis: Someone dark returns from Julia's past with bad intentions. Gabriel has secrets he needs to share, but worries that he'll lose everything if he does. Will their relationship weather the test of secrets revealed?

title: Clouds
synopsis: Based on real events, a young musician discovers his cancer has spread, leaving him just a few months to live. With limited time, he follows his dream and makes an album, unaware that it will soon be a viral music phenomenon.

title: Life in a Year
synopsis: The movie follows 17-year-old Daryn who finds out that his girlfriend is dying. He sets out to give her an entire life in the last year she has left.

title: Evangelion: 3.0+1.0 Thrice Upon a Time
director: Hideaki Anno, Mahiro Maeda, Katsuichi Nakayama
synopsis: Misato and her anti-NERV group WILLE arrive in Paris, a city now red from core-ization. Crew from the flagship Wunder land on a containment tower.

title: Justice League Dark: Apokolips War
synopsis: A Sequel to Justice League Dark (2017) involving Jack Kirby's New Gods.

title: My Hero Academia: Heroes Rising
synopsis: A group of youths aspiring to become professional superheroes, fight in a world full of people with abilities, also known as quirks. Deku and his fellow classmates from Hero Academy face Nine, the strongest villain yet.

title: Piper
synopsis: A hungry sandpiper hatchling ventures from her nest for the first time to dig for food by the shoreline. The problem is, the food is buried in the sand where scary waves roll up.

title: Miraculous World: New York, United Heroez
synopsis: Marinette's class is headed to New York, the city of superheroes, for French American Friendship Week, but the American superheroes may find themselves in need of help while there.

title: There's Still Tomorrow
synopsis: In this moving comedic drama set in postwar Rome, a working-class wife and mother dreams of a better future. Winner of 6 Italian Academy Awards.

title: How to Train Your Dragon: Homecoming
synopsis: Hiccup and Toothless reunite to remind both their kinds of the inseparable bond between vikings and dragons.

title: On My Skin: The Last Seven Days of Stefano Cucchi
synopsis: The incredible true story behind the most controversial Italian court cases in recent years. Stefano Cucchi was arrested for a minor crime but in just one week's time, a family is changed forever.

title: Paperman
synopsis: An office worker meets the girl of his dreams and uses a fleet of paper airplanes to get her attention.

title: Three Men and a Leg
director: Aldo Baglio, Giacomo Poretti, Giovanni Storti
synopsis: Three friends cross Italy by car in order to deliver their boss his dog and a wooden leg.

title: In a Heartbeat
